sections.title: What You'll Learn
sections.content:
Ready to learn **Overloading Methods**?

Here's what we'll cover:

• Multiple methods with same name
• Why this matters for your coding journey
• Hands-on examples you can try

sections.title: Core Concepts
sections.content:
Think of **Overloading Methods** like building blocks. 

Every great program starts with small, simple pieces. This is one of those essential pieces!

• Start simple, then build up
• Practice makes it click
• Don't worry if it takes time - totally normal!

sections.title: Code Examples
Key Points
points: Overloaded methods share the same name but differ in their parameter lists
The compiler selects the correct method based on the number and types of arguments
Return type alone is not sufficient to distinguish overloaded methods
Overloading allows the same operation to work with different parameter types
Ambiguous overloading causes a compilation error when the compiler cannot determine which method to call

sections.title: Summary
sections.content: Overloading Methods - Multiple methods with same name. Master basics before advancing. Practice with the examples. Builds foundation for what's next.
